import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, platform, subprocess, time
R=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/longhorn/nvme-02/freetoken')
W=R/'wt-astra-concurrent-wall-client'; S=R/'wt-plegather'
unit='astra-sustained-hot-staging-wall-driver'
def status(name):
 p=subprocess.run(['systemctl','show',name,'--property=Id,ActiveState,MainPID,Result,ExecMainStatus,InvocationID'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 return dict(line.split('=',1) for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if '=' in line)
before={name:status(name) for name in (unit,'freetoken-serve')}
assert before[unit]['ActiveState']=='inactive',before
assert before[unit]['Result']=='success' and before[unit]['ExecMainStatus']=='0',before
assert before[unit]['InvocationID'] in ('','681b7edf0c07456e89e4ba087014022d'),before
assert before['freetoken-serve']['ActiveState']=='active',before
last=json.loads((R/'results/astra-sustained-hot-staging-wall-r4-metadata.json').read_text())
assert last['completed']
assert last['original_serving_restoration']['choices'][0]['message']['content'].strip()=='OK'
assert not W.exists(),W
subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R/'FreeToken'),'fetch',str(R/'tmp/astra-concurrent-wall-client.bundle'),'perf/4090-concurrent-wall-client:refs/heads/bench/astra-concurrent-wall-client'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R/'FreeToken'),'worktree','add',str(W),'bench/astra-concurrent-wall-client'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(W),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert revision=='c0775ea48b108dcf31d80091a8d36c81d5239edf'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(W),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
files=['bench/concurrent-prefill-wall.py','tests/test_concurrent_prefill_client.py']
cmd=[str(S/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_concurrent_prefill_client.py']
started=time.monotonic()
p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=W,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(W/'python')),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
report=dict(revision=revision,platform=platform.platform(),before=before,args=cmd,returncode=p.returncode,wall_s=time.monotonic()-started,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr,source_sha256={name:hashlib.sha256((W/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},after={name:status(name) for name in before},prior_original_serving_restoration=last['original_serving_restoration'],driver_source=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text())
(R/'results/astra-concurrent-wall-client-linux-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
assert report['after']['freetoken-serve']['ActiveState']=='active'
assert report['after']['freetoken-serve']['MainPID']==before['freetoken-serve']['MainPID']
